				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-3c75306 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="3c75306" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<p class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Snowkitecamp</p>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-dfb30fe elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="dfb30fe" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<p class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Norway</p>				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2284caf e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="2284caf" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9fa2c81 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="9fa2c81" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4984d2e elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="4984d2e" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>In the spring, from the end of March to the beginning of April, the conditions in Norway are optimal for kiting for miles, going on short snowkite tours, and perfecting your snowkiting jumps.</p><p>Even if you are a beginner at kitesurfing on snow: If you can ski or snowboard and have flown a kite before, you will be gliding independently through the Norwegian landscape in no time.</p><p><span style="font-family: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-family ), Sans-serif; font-size: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-size ); font-weight: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-weight );">Nowhere else in the world you can find better conditions for our snowkite camp. </span>Come snowkiting with us to Norway and discover the magic of the north!</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b068830 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="b068830" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Are you ready for meters of snow, endless hills and crackling open fires in our own hut in the Norwegian mountains? <span style="font-family: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-family ), Sans-serif; font-size: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-size ); font-weight: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-weight );">Norway is the holy grail of snow kiting. </span>If you just return with our group from a 30 km long snow kite tour through the smooth powder landscape, then jump into the sauna in your own hut, cook together and end the evening with a glass of red wine in front of the crackling fireplace, then you know what we mean by 'the Magic of Norway'.<span style="font-family: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-family ), Sans-serif; font-size: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-size ); font-weight: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-weight );"> </span></p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6dabf00 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="6dabf00" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The holy grail</p>								</div>
				</div>

									<div id="elementor-tab-title-6072" class="elementor-tab-title elementor-tab-desktop-title" aria-selected="false" data-tab="2" role="tab" tabindex="-1" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-6072" aria-expanded="false">Planning arrival and departure</div>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-6071" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-6071" tabindex="0" hidden="false"><h4>Snowkitecamp Norway</h4><p class="translation-block">7 nights in a cozy mountain hut (double room, electricity costs included)</p><ul><li><strong>Including</strong> Supervision, Guidance, and GPS Tracker</li><li><strong>Excluding</strong> Arrival, equipment rental (soft kites), rental car, meals (group fund)</li></ul></div>
									<div class="elementor-tab-title elementor-tab-mobile-title" aria-selected="false" data-tab="2" role="tab" tabindex="-1" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-6072" aria-expanded="false">Planning arrival and departure</div>
					<div id="elementor-tab-content-6072" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-6072" tabindex="0" hidden="hidden"><p>In our rooms in Norway <strong>Check-in from 6:00 PM</strong> on.</p><p class="translation-block">In our WhatsApp group, we organize carpools and rental cars to travel from Bergen Airport (approximately a 3-hour drive) and Oslo Airport (approximately a 4-5 hour drive) to Vøringsfoss. Traveling via Bergen has the advantage that you can arrive directly even in heavy snow and ice conditions, without having to detour around potentially closed mountain passes.</p><p class="translation-block">Arrival and departure by public train (Bergen Railway) and further travel in a carpool is also possible.</p><p><strong>The last day is for departure, check-out is at 9:15 a.m</strong>. We recommend booking a flight later in the day home from Oslo or Bergen due to the travel time to the airport.</p></div>

		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-80ee7d5 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="80ee7d5" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7529078 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="7529078" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Powder &amp; endless landscapes </p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9a6cf4d elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="9a6cf4d" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Spot &amp; wind in Norway</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4b22a94 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="4b22a94" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2b9fb1f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="2b9fb1f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The “Hardanggervidda” plateau is approximately three hours away from Oslo. With its flat lakes and gentle hills / mountains it is the largest high plateau in Europe. In winter it is a huge playground for snow kiting. The Star Wars film "The Empire Strikes Back" was also shot there! With the kite you could then go all day in one direction without even having to turn around. Great right?</p><p>A road runs across the plateau, so we can drive directly to the spot, set up at the parking lot and go kiting. Very pleasant if you want to change the kite quickly or warm up in the car. It is also a neat plus in terms of safety, because if you want you can drive miles and still stay close to the road.</p><p>The weather changes relatively often due to the plateau's weather divide. But that's a good thing because we are always supplied with fresh powder. And you don't have to worry about the wind anyway. They are very local wind systems that we know perfectly after ten years of experience. We always find the wind!</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8e0d0dd elementor-hidden-phone e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="8e0d0dd" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The Ikea feel-good hut</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-443f434 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="443f434" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Accommodation in Norway</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8685528 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="8685528" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5487012 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="5487012" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Our accommodation is located in Vøringsfoss, a small village in the Vestland region, very close to the Hardangervidda National Park. Norway's largest national park is known for its impressive high plateaus – our snowkiting area for this week.</p><p>The cozy cabin sits on a small hill. Furnished in Scandinavian style, it offers absolute comfort. In total, we have five double bedrooms with two bathrooms, a modern kitchen, and a spacious living and lounge area at our disposal.</p><p>Imagine relaxing in your warm living room after a day of kitesurfing and covering many kilometers in the snow-covered landscape, wrapped in a cozy blanket, a cup of tea in your hand… That is hygge.</p>								</div>

									<p>There is plenty to do</p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0bf4908 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="0bf4908" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Activities Snowkitecamp Norway</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-788b523 elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="788b523" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8bcdf3f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="8bcdf3f" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p><strong>Skiing</strong></p><p>If the pass road is closed due to a storm, we drive to the nearby Geilo ski area. There wide carving slopes invite you to speedy rides. They are perfectly prepared until the evening. Almost no people will be expecting us on the slopes and the waiting time at the lift is zero.</p><p><strong>Fjord excursion:</strong></p><p>At the other end of Plateau Road, Norway's largest waterfall falls 120 meters into a mighty gorge. Of course we look at that from a skywalk that towers over the abyss. We're going to throw snowballs down and count the seconds. Then you go 1,500 meters further down to the spectacular Eidfjord. There you will have the feeling that a Viking ship could pass by at any time. Last year we even saw elections there. A spectacular experience!</p><p><strong>Farewell dinner:</strong></p><p>On the last evening, our friend Björn will host a final dinner at his snowkiting hotel. You can fill your stomach at the all-you-can-eat buffet, because Björn's food is truly unique and ranks among our top three.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-be02a5f e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="be02a5f" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-92a1614 elementor-widget elementor-widget-gallery" data-id="92a1614" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;columns&quot;:2,&quot;aspect_ratio&quot;:&quot;4:3&quot;,&quot;columns_mobile&quot;:2,&quot;lazyload&quot;:&quot;yes&quot;,&quot;gallery_layout&quot;:&quot;grid&quot;,&quot;columns_tablet&quot;:2,&quot;gap&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:10,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;gap_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:10,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;gap_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:10,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;overlay_background&quot;:&quot;yes&quot;}" data-widget_type="gallery.default">

					<div class="elementor-cta__bg-wrapper">

							<div class="elementor-cta__content">

									<h3 class="elementor-cta__title elementor-cta__content-item elementor-content-item elementor-animated-item--grow">
						Another item for your bucket list					</h3>

									<div class="elementor-cta__description elementor-cta__content-item elementor-content-item elementor-animated-item--grow">
						Snowy adventure in the Austrian Alps: Snowkitecamp with ski touring and avalanche training.					</div>

									<div class="elementor-cta__button-wrapper elementor-cta__content-item elementor-content-item elementor-animated-item--grow">
					<span class="elementor-cta__button elementor-button elementor-size-">
						Learn more					</span>

				<div class="elementor-ribbon-inner">
					Camp				</div>

				</a>
						</div>

		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-64c93b5 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="64c93b5" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2b2ac87 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="2b2ac87" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7f5b686 elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="7f5b686" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h3 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Detailed information on the Snowkitecamp in Norway</h3>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6eedbc7 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="6eedbc7" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>We have been traveling to Norway ourselves and with groups for years and are very familiar with both traveling to and in the country and snowkiting at various spots. </p><p>We have briefly summarized all the useful information for you.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5706148 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="5706148" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7c4e8e8 elementor-widget elementor-widget-toggle" data-id="7c4e8e8" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;none&quot;}" data-widget_type="toggle.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
							<div class="elementor-toggle">
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-1301" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="1" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1301" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">What does a day look like at the snowkitecamp?</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1301" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="1" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1301"><p>A certain routine always develops very quickly. The house wakes up at around eight o'clock - very slowly and without an alarm clock. There is stress elsewhere, but not with us.</p><p>First there is a decent breakfast with Norwegian strawberry jam (insider tip!) eggs, bacon and fresh fruit, because you need strength for the day. At ten o'clock we drive up to the plateau. </p><p>We choose the spot with the best wind and snow conditions. We kite there all day long and usually take breaks near our car. A group can get together and take a longer break and drive to a café at the pass and treat themselves to a coffee with insanely delicious waffles by the fireplace or an exorbitantly expensive € 10.- beer. But it tastes fantastic. </p><p>At around 5:00 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. we will return to the hut. Then the sauna is turned on and we cook together. We end the evening by the open fireplace with a large glass of red wine.</p><p>You get as much practice time in Norway as you do in Austria in four years. This will make you tremendous progress. Even we ourselves are always surprised how much one can learn there!</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-1302" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="2" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1302" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">What equipment do I need? Is there a snowkite equipment rental service?</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1302" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="2" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1302"><p>It definitely makes sense to use our kite material, because then you are always well equipped for all conditions. So if you do not have your own or not the appropriate equipment, you are welcome to rent it from us, in Norway we have Peak, Hybrid and Soul with us.</p><p>Flysurfer specializes in foil kites and you can't go wrong with that.</p><p>We would also recommend you to consider a dedicated snowkite harness. Many camp participants  discover on site how comfortable a special harness can be for snowkiting.</p><p>If you don't have your own or want to test one, let us know and we'll include the right one for you to rent. By the way, you'll receive the <strong>Rent applied to purchase price if you keep the trapeze after camp</strong>.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-1303" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="3" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1303" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">What is included in the supervision?</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1303" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="3" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1303"><p>We offer supervision during this camp. Our coaches will be on-site to give you tips and answer your questions. However, there will be no traditional kitesurfing lessons or coaching.</p><p>The entry requirements for our snowkiting camp in Norway are quickly met thanks to the perfect conditions: If you can ski or snowboard and have flown a kite before, you'll be cruising in no time yourself.</p><p>The Norwegian terrain guarantees rapid learning success. You'll usually have to reset your goals within the week—no, we're not being arrogant about that at all.</p><p>In one week, you'll get as many practice hours as we would get in several years. This way, you'll learn a tremendous amount. Kite handling is key, whether on the water or on the snow. That's exactly what you'll perfect here in Norway.</p><p>You get amazingly good light wind skills and learn how to loop up the mountain. You will also practice your kite relaunch and become a better kiter in general.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-1304" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="4" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1304" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">Where is our accommodation located at the Snowkitecamp Norway?</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1304" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="4" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1304"><p>The accommodation is located in Vøringsfoss, a small village in the municipality of Eidfjord in the province of Vestland, Norway. It is in close proximity to Hardangervidda National Park, Norway's largest national park, known for its impressive plateaus, waterfalls, and diverse wildlife.</p><p>Our cabin is decorated in Scandinavian style and offers absolute comfort. Equipped with five double rooms with two bathrooms, a modern kitchen, and a spacious living and dining area.</p><p>A guarantee for cozy evenings!</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-1305" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="5" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1305" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">How is the catering organized on site?</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1305" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="5" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1305"><p>We dedicate € 150.- budget per person for food. We have eaten very well for this amount in recent years, because shopping for the group makes it cheaper. As an individual, the budget would be used up in three days. We always cook together in the evening and end the day comfortably in front of the fireplace.</p>
<p>Once we will have pizza in Geilo and on the last evening (Saturday) there will be a final dinner in the snowkit hotel.&nbsp;</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-1306" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="6" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1306" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">What's the best way to get to the snowkite camp?</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1306" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="6" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1306"><p>Ideally, you should travel via Bergen and then drive to Vøringsfoss in about 3 hours by rental car. Alternatively, you can fly into Oslo Airport (about a 4-5 hour drive by rental car). Traveling via Bergen has the advantage that you can arrive directly even in heavy snow and ice conditions, without having to detour around potentially closed mountain passes.</p><p>Arrival and departure by public train (Bergen Railway) and then carpooling is also possible. We will coordinate carpools with you so that you can get from the airport to the meeting point in Vøringsfoss as quickly and cheaply as possible.</p><p>Some airlines allow you to add ski luggage to your flight for free. This allows you to bring 8 kg of hand luggage, 23 kg of regular luggage, and 23 kg of ski luggage. We often add a kite or two to our ski luggage.</p></div>
				</div>
							<div class="elementor-toggle-item">
					<h5 id="elementor-tab-title-1307" class="elementor-tab-title" data-tab="7" role="button" aria-controls="elementor-tab-content-1307" aria-expanded="false">
												<span class="elementor-toggle-icon elementor-toggle-icon-right" aria-hidden="true">
															<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-closed"><i class="fas fa-caret-right"></i></span>
								<span class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened"><i class="elementor-toggle-icon-opened fas fa-caret-up"></i></span>
													</span>
												<a class="elementor-toggle-title" tabindex="0">What do I need to consider when travelling to Norway for snowkiting?</a>
					</h5>

					<div id="elementor-tab-content-1307" class="elementor-tab-content elementor-clearfix" data-tab="7" role="region" aria-labelledby="elementor-tab-title-1307"><p><strong>Money</strong>: You don't need to exchange money in advance. You can pay for almost everything with a card in Norway, even in the smallest café in the middle of nowhere.</p><p><strong>Internet</strong>: Norway is in the EU roaming zone. That means you can use your mobile internet as normal and consume your free units.</p><p><strong>Passport</strong>: You need a valid passport or identity card for the duration of your stay.</p><p><strong>Travel insurance</strong>We're not insurance agents, but we're committed to offering you comprehensive travel insurance. And in truth, cancellation and travel insurance does make sense. You can choose an insurance package when booking.</p><p><strong>Material insurance</strong>:<br />With the VDWS Safety Tool, you're insured against damage to rental equipment. It's saved us a lot of stress, which is why we definitely recommend the VDWS Safety Tool! You can find more information here: https://www.vdws.de/safetytool/VY99056</p></div>
				</div>
								</div>
						</div>
				</div>
